game_title: Nested Registry – Cloud Sea Overlook Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Nested Registry: Navigate dictionaries inside dictionaries to find the right record.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Navigate dictionaries inside dictionaries to find the right record. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the avalanche scout ahead. Then check the registry value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the pass gate by solving code steps involving registry that move the avalanche scout forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the pass gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Nested Registry
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Registry' (Week 8 slot 12), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how registry changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
